reviewScope: Condition definitions only; no complete SRD dataset is claimed.
method: The condition names and mechanics summaries were checked against the specified pages in the official Wizards PDFs. Summaries are condensed and arranged as JSON records; source page wording was not copied verbatim.

2014-SRD-5.1: Petrified condition: excluded because PDF text extraction on its source page was corrupted and the extracted wording could not be verified reliably.
All SRD sections other than the listed conditions.
2024-SRD-5.2.1: All SRD sections other than the listed conditions.

attributionAndChangeNotes: Each asset embeds the exact attribution statement required by its SRD PDF, the full CC BY 4.0 legal text, and a notice that its condition summaries were condensed and converted to JSON.
